description: I3: App-side rules, evaluated with alerts.json and operations.json once infra/observe/rules.py merges this file (WR-I3-3). The App runs on Vercel with no exporter on the box; its one box-visible signal is the canary's anonymous probe of the App's release identity (WR-I3-2 adds it to canary.sh). Browser and server error rates live in Vercel's logs, not here: their thresholds are Vercel-side [OP] (infra/app/operations.md, Browser error monitoring). Same rule shape and threshold conventions as alerts.json.

rules.summary: The App's public release identity (GET /api/version on the App origin) did not answer 200 with a production environment and a full commit: the App is down, refusing to start (incomplete environment) or serving an unidentified build.
